name: iOS Capability Architect
long_description: Turn an iOS or Apple-platform product idea into an implementable capability map, SwiftUI-first architecture, permission and entitlement inventory, privacy review, delivery sequence, and test plan. When a local project is in scope, compare selected capability requirements with Xcode, XcodeGen, plist, entitlement, xcconfig, Swift package, and privacy-manifest source configuration through a bounded read-only audit. The plugin distinguishes verified profiles from discovery-only catalog entries, preserves unknown and manual-review states, and links material platform claims to official Apple sources.
